thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: org=zephyrhealth-prod has tripped per-org rate limiter (95th p95 errors > 8%). Auto-mitigation candidate suggested: temporary soft-rl bump to 3rps and disable heavy route 'text-search-long'.
alice_oncall: got the page, I'm on. looking at dashboard now. p95 latency up, errors are 429s and some 504s.
brian_sre: copying in. can you paste the org id and current rl config? I'll prep the quickpatch command.
alice_oncall: org id: org_0xZEPHYR. current RL: 1rps burst=5. traffic spike started ~2801234400.
carla_infra: if we bump RL we should also disable long-running model route for that org to avoid KV cache blowout. suggest disabling route: /v1/generate/longform for zephyr.
alice_oncall: agreed. running dry-run to validate target nodes have capacity.
incident-bot: Action suggested by mitigation-suggester: `rl adjust --org org_0xZEPHYR --rate 3 --burst 10 --reason "emergency spike relief"`
brian_sre: I will apply RL bump and flip route flag. executing now.
brian_sre: RUN: `infra-cli rl apply --org org_0xZEPHYR --rate 3 --burst 10 --scope per-org --ttl 20m`  
brian_sre: RUN: `ff toggle --org org_0xZEPHYR --route text-search-long --state off --reason "mitigate spike"`
alice_oncall: applied. seeing immediate drop in 429s from 18% -> 6% over the last 30s. latency still elevated but trending down.
dave_support: reaching out to Zephyr's support contact to give heads-up and ETA. drafting message now.
erin_am: thanks — I'll join the customer thread and let them know it's a temporary relief while we investigate root cause. cc @frank_pm if product needs to inform partners.
frank_pm: noted. can we collect a sample of requests that triggered the spike? suspicious patterns around large embeddings + streaming.
carla_infra: collecting logs now. looks like a set of clients calling longform with seq_len > 4k repeatedly. probable runaway job or misconfigured retry logic.
brian_sre: copying out an example payload and appid to hand to support for throttle guidance.
alice_oncall: monitoring alert: p95 errors down to 3.8% after actions. RL bump + route disable is working. will keep RL bump for 20m as set; if stable we can ramp down earlier.
incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation applied by brian_sre: temporary-rl(org_0xZEPHYR)=3rps ttl=20m; feature-toggle text-search-long disabled for org_0xZEPHYR. Audit ID: audit_280123.
dave_support: sent message to customer: "We're seeing a high-volume pattern from your integration causing rate errors. We've applied a temporary rate increase and disabled a heavy route while we investigate. We will follow up with logs and recommended client-side fixes." They acknowledged and asked for ETA.
erin_am: customer is responsive. they say they have a backend job that kicked off last night; will pause it. we should coordinate when to re-enable route.
alice_oncall: plan: keep temp-rl for 20m, watch errors/latency for 10m, then set RL back to 1rps and re-enable route only after confirmation from customer and ops. create follow-up ticket for postmortem.
frank_pm: create a short postmortem and a playbook entry for "org spike remediations: temp-rl + route flip" so support has cookbook steps.
brian_sre: created ticket INF-8421 (postmortem + playbook). also added a task to add better telemetry on per-route seq_len distribution.
carla_infra: note for SREs: avoid global RL changes; prefer per-org soft bumps + route toggles. adding that to the ticket.
alice_oncall: incident status: mitigated (customer impact reduced). oncall handing back to SRE rotation in 5m pending stability. tagging this thread resolved in 30m if no regressions.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. responders: alice_oncall, brian_sre, carla_infra. escalation: none. "next steps" added to INF-8421.
alice_oncall: thanks team. great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
